dedupe_keys.name: spanish cadastre inspire buildings bu parcels and addresses services

description: The Dirección General del Catastro, Spain's cadastre directorate, publishes INSPIRE-conformant datasets and services as its contribution to the Spanish Spatial Data Infrastructure: Cadastral Parcels (CP), Addresses (AD) and Buildings (BU), each with XML metadata. A WMS view service shows current information as in the cadastre's electronic office, and download services include WFS for parcels, addresses and buildings, with dataset downloads. Coverage: Spain, within the cadastre's competence. Access: services and downloads listed on the Catastro INSPIRE page. Licence: the Catastro licence of access and use for INSPIRE datasets and services, linked from the page; free. Caveats: the INSPIRE buildings model carries a limited set of attributes, and the page read does not say which regions fall outside the directorate's competence. Simulation uses are building footprints and attributes for flood, earthquake and energy models across Spain. Related records: the INSPIRE Buildings data specification.
